103	// NOTE: You can ignore certain refinements on a template level by updating the below

105	const REFINEMENT_DISALLOW_LIST = ['c_isNew']
106	
107	/*
108	 * This is a simple product listing page. It displays a paginated list
109	 * of product hit objects. Allowing for sorting and filtering based on the

112	const ProductList = (props) => {
113	    // Using destructuring to omit properties; we must rename `isLoading` because we use a different
114	    // `isLoading` later in this function.
115	    // eslint-disable-next-line react/prop-types, @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars

132	    /**************** Page State ****************/
133	    const [filtersLoading, setFiltersLoading] = useState(false)
134	    const [wishlistLoading, setWishlistLoading] = useState([])
135	    const [sortOpen, setSortOpen] = useState(false)
136	    const [searchByInventory, setSearchByInventory] = useState(null)
137	
138	    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
139	    let searchQuery = urlParams.get('q')
140	    const isSearch = !!searchQuery
141	
142	    if (params.categoryId) {
143	        searchParams._refine.push(`cgid=${params.categoryId}`)
144	    }
145	
146	    /**************** Mutation Actions ****************/
147	    const {mutateAsync: createCustomerProductListItem} = useShopperCustomersMutation(
148	        'createCustomerProductListItem'
149	    )
150	    const {mutateAsync: deleteCustomerProductListItem} = useShopperCustomersMutation(
151	        'deleteCustomerProductListItem'
152	    )
153	
154	    /**************** Query Actions ****************/
155	    // _refine is an invalid param for useProductSearch, we don't want to pass it to API call
156	    const {_refine, ...restOfParams} = searchParams
157	
158	    const refine = searchByInventory ? [..._refine, `ilids=${searchByInventory}`] : _refine
159	
160	    const {
161	        isLoading,
162	        isFetched,
163	        isRefetching,
164	        data: productSearchResult
165	    } = useProductSearch(
166	        {
167	            parameters: {
168	                ...restOfParams,
169	                perPricebook: true,
170	                allVariationProperties: true,
171	                allImages: true,
172	                expand: [
173	                    'promotions',
174	                    'variations',
175	                    'prices',
176	                    'images',
177	                    'page_meta_tags',
178	                    'custom_properties'
179	                ],
180	                refine
181	            }
182	        },
183	        {
184	            keepPreviousData: true
185	        }
186	    )
187	
188	    const {error, data: category} = useCategory(
189	        {
190	            parameters: {
191	                id: params.categoryId
192	            }
193	        },
194	        {
195	            enabled: !isSearch && !!params.categoryId
196	        }
197	    )
198	
199	    // Apply disallow list to refinements.
200	    if (productSearchResult?.refinements) {
201	        productSearchResult.refinements = productSearchResult.refinements.filter(
202	            ({attributeId}) => !REFINEMENT_DISALLOW_LIST.includes(attributeId)
203	        )
204	    }
205	
206	    /**************** Error Handling ****************/
207	    const errorStatus = error?.response?.status
208	    switch (errorStatus) {
209	        case undefined:
210	            // No Error.
211	            break
212	        case 404:
213	            throw new HTTPNotFound('Category Not Found.')
214	        default:
215	            throw new HTTPError(errorStatus, `HTTP Error ${errorStatus} occurred.`)
216	    }
217	
218	    /**************** Response Handling ****************/
219	    if (res) {
220	        res.set(
221	            'Cache-Control',
222	            `s-maxage=${MAX_CACHE_AGE}, stale-while-revalidate=${STALE_WHILE_REVALIDATE}`
223	        )
224	    }
225	
226	    // Reset scroll position when `isRefetching` becomes `true`.
227	    useEffect(() => {
228	        isRefetching && window.scrollTo(0, 0)
229	        setFiltersLoading(isRefetching)
230	    }, [isRefetching])
231	
232	    /**************** Render Variables ****************/
233	    const basePath = `${location.pathname}${location.search}`
234	    const showNoResults = !isLoading && productSearchResult && !productSearchResult?.hits
235	    const {total, sortingOptions} = productSearchResult || {}
236	    const selectedSortingOptionLabel =
237	        sortingOptions?.find(
238	            (option) => option.id === productSearchResult?.selectedSortingOption
239	        ) ?? sortingOptions?.[0]
240	
241	    // Get urls to be used for pagination, page size changes, and sorting.
242	    const pageUrls = usePageUrls({total})
243	    const sortUrls = useSortUrls({options: sortingOptions})
244	    const limitUrls = useLimitUrls()
245	
246	    /**************** Action Handlers ****************/
247	    const {data: wishlist} = useWishList()
248	    const addItemToWishlist = async (product) => {
249	        setWishlistLoading([...wishlistLoading, product.productId])
250	
251	        // TODO: This wishlist object is from an old API, we need to replace it with the new one.
252	        const listId = wishlist.id
253	        await createCustomerProductListItem(
254	            {
255	                parameters: {customerId, listId},
256	                body: {
257	                    quantity: 1,
258	                    public: false,
259	                    priority: 1,
260	                    type: 'product',
261	                    productId: product.productId
262	                }
263	            },
264	            {
265	                onError: () => {
266	                    toast({
267	                        title: formatMessage(API_ERROR_MESSAGE),
268	                        status: 'error'
269	                    })
270	                },
271	                onSuccess: () => {
272	                    toast({
273	                        title: formatMessage(TOAST_MESSAGE_ADDED_TO_WISHLIST, {quantity: 1}),
274	                        status: 'success',
275	                        action: (
276	                            // it would be better if we could use <Button as={Link}>
277	                            // but unfortunately the Link component is not compatible
278	                            // with Chakra Toast, since the ToastManager is rendered via portal
279	                            // and the toast doesn't have access to intl provider, which is a
280	                            // requirement of the Link component.
281	                            <Button variant="link" onClick={() => navigate('/account/wishlist')}>
282	                                {formatMessage(TOAST_ACTION_VIEW_WISHLIST)}
283	                            </Button>
284	                        )
285	                    })
286	                },
287	                onSettled: () => {
288	                    setWishlistLoading(wishlistLoading.filter((id) => id !== product.productId))
289	                }
290	            }
291	        )
292	    }
293	
294	    const removeItemFromWishlist = async (product) => {
295	        setWishlistLoading([...wishlistLoading, product.productId])
296	
297	        const listId = wishlist.id
298	        const itemId = wishlist.customerProductListItems.find(
299	            (i) => i.productId === product.productId
300	        ).id
301	
302	        await deleteCustomerProductListItem(
303	            {
304	                body: {},
305	                parameters: {customerId, listId, itemId}
306	            },
307	            {
308	                onError: () => {
309	                    toast({
310	                        title: formatMessage(API_ERROR_MESSAGE),
311	                        status: 'error'
312	                    })
313	                },
314	                onSuccess: () => {
315	                    toast({
316	                        title: formatMessage(TOAST_MESSAGE_REMOVED_FROM_WISHLIST),
317	                        status: 'success'
318	                    })
319	                },
320	                onSettled: () => {
321	                    setWishlistLoading(wishlistLoading.filter((id) => id !== product.productId))
322	                }
323	            }
324	        )
325	    }
326	
327	    // Toggles filter on and off
328	    const toggleFilter = (value, attributeId, selected, allowMultiple = true) => {
329	        // Special handling for inventory filter
330	        if (attributeId === 'ilids') {
331	            if (!selected) {
332	                setSearchByInventory(value.value)
333	            } else {
334	                setSearchByInventory(null)
335	            }
336	            return
337	        }
338	
339	        const searchParamsCopy = {...searchParams}
340	
341	        // Remove the `offset` search param if present.
342	        delete searchParamsCopy.offset
343	
344	        // If we aren't allowing for multiple selections, simply clear any value set for the
345	        // attribute, and apply a new one if required.
346	        if (!allowMultiple) {
347	            const previousValue = searchParamsCopy.refine[attributeId]
348	            delete searchParamsCopy.refine[attributeId]
349	
350	            // Note the loose comparison, for "string != number" checks.
351	            if (!selected && value.value != previousValue) {
352	                searchParamsCopy.refine[attributeId] = value.value
353	            }
354	        } else {
355	            // Get the attibute value as an array.
356	            let attributeValue = searchParamsCopy.refine[attributeId] || []
357	
358	            // Ensure that the value is still converted into an array if it's a `string` or `number`.
359	            if (typeof attributeValue === 'string') {
360	                attributeValue = attributeValue.split('|')
361	            } else if (typeof attributeValue === 'number') {
362	                attributeValue = [attributeValue]
363	            }
364	
365	            // Either set the value, or filter the value out.
366	            if (!selected) {
367	                attributeValue.push(value.value)
368	            } else {
369	                // Note the loose comparison, for "string != number" checks.
370	                attributeValue = attributeValue?.filter((v) => v != value.value)
371	            }
372	
373	            // Update the attribute value in the new search params.
374	            searchParamsCopy.refine[attributeId] = attributeValue
375	
376	            // If the update value is an empty array, remove the current attribute key.
377	            if (searchParamsCopy.refine[attributeId].length === 0) {
378	                delete searchParamsCopy.refine[attributeId]
379	            }
380	        }
381	
382	        if (isSearch) {
383	            navigate(`/search?${stringifySearchParams(searchParamsCopy)}`)
384	        } else {
385	            navigate(`/category/${params.categoryId}?${stringifySearchParams(searchParamsCopy)}`)
386	        }
387	    }
388	
389	    // Clears all filters
390	    const resetFilters = () => {
391	        const newSearchParams = {
392	            ...searchParams,
393	            refine: []
394	        }
395	        setSearchByInventory(null)
396	        const newPath = isSearch
397	            ? `/search?${stringifySearchParams(newSearchParams)}`
398	            : `/category/${params.categoryId}?${stringifySearchParams(newSearchParams)}`
399	
400	        navigate(newPath)
401	    }
402	
403	    // Helper function to create StoreInventoryFilter component
404	    const createStoreInventoryFilter = () => {
405	        if (!storeLocatorEnabled) return null
406	        return (
407	            <StoreInventoryFilter
408	                key="storeInventoryFilter"
409	                toggleFilter={toggleFilter}
410	                selectedFilters={productSearchResult?.selectedRefinements || {}}
411	            />
412	        )
413	    }
414	
415	    /**************** Einstein ****************/
416	    useEffect(() => {
417	        if (productSearchResult) {
418	            if (isSearch) {
419	                try {
420	                    einstein.sendViewSearch(searchQuery, productSearchResult)
421	                } catch (err) {
422	                    logger.error('Einstein sendViewSearch error', {
423	                        namespace: 'ProductList.useEffect',
424	                        additionalProperties: {error: err, searchQuery}
425	                    })
426	                }

430	                try {
431	                    einstein.sendViewCategory(category, productSearchResult)

31	 *
32	 * Vertical rhythm is expressed as `marginTop` on each row rather than a uniform `root.gap`,
